note: Layout treatments for the offer-first text layer: WHERE the text goes. Typography and effects come from offer-styles.json and colour from offer-palettes.json, so any treatment can be combined with any style and palette. A layout holds one or more text groups. Each group owns a fixed region; its lines are fitted to their share of that region, then stacked from the group's anchor edge using real rendered heights, so no text can leave the region.

schema.groups: Each group: id, region [x, y, w, h] in % of the canvas, anchor (top | center | bottom), align (left | center | right), gap_pct (space between items, % of canvas height), scrim, stack, and optionally band. Groups never overlap. Hierarchy and verification span every group.
schema.stack: Ordered items. A text line is { block, share, max_lines, min_px, optional? } where block is location | audience | duration | offer_name. A divider is { block: 'divider', width_pct (of the group's width), thickness_pct (of canvas height), space_pct? (extra room above and below it, % of canvas height) }; it is drawn only when there is text on both sides of it, and it is never counted as text.
schema.scrim: { direction, fade_pct }. direction is none | top | bottom | left | right | even. The scrim is full strength from the text's edge outward, and fades over fade_pct beyond it, so every letter sits on the full-strength part and the contrast maths stays exact. A group's scrim may not reach another group's region; 'even' covers the whole canvas and is only allowed in single-group layouts.
schema.band: { mode, shape, blocks, pad_pct, radius_pct }. A solid band behind some of the group's lines, whatever the style. mode 'full' is one band spanning the group's full width; 'line' is a bar hugging each line of text. shape 'pill' is rounded, 'bar' square. Text on a band is judged against the band colour.
schema.clear_zones: [{ name, rect [x, y, w, h] }] in % of the canvas: space kept free of text for the subject. No group region may touch one, and the verifier checks every line, band and divider against them.
schema.background: Optional. { type: 'single' } (default: one photo, cover-fitted) · { type: 'collage', cols, rows, min_images } (the photos in order, repeating to fill the grid; min_images must exceed cols so no photo sits next to itself) · { type: 'panels', backdrop, min_images, panels: [{ shape: 'circle', cx, cy, r }] } (photos cropped to circles on a solid backdrop; cx, r in % of width, cy in % of height). Panels are keep-out areas: no text, band or divider may touch one.

safe_area_note: [x, y, w, h] in % of the canvas: every line, band and divider must sit inside it, and every group region is validated against it. 1:1 keeps a 5% margin. 9:16 is Meta's unified Stories/Reels safe zone (March 2026): the top 14% (profile row), the bottom 35% (caption, like/comment/share, CTA) and 6% each side are covered by the app. Source: Meta Business Help Centre, 'About text overlays and the Safe Zone for ads in Stories and Reels'.
derivation_note: A ratio with no explicit layout is derived from the 1:1 layout: its safe area is mapped onto the target's (x' = x0' + (x - x0) * w'/w, likewise y), and every length in % of the canvas is scaled with it — gaps, fades, divider thickness and spacing, band padding and radius, panel radius. Collage rows scale with the canvas's height, to keep tiles near-square. An explicit layouts['9x16'] overrides the derived one.

t1-bottom-stack.name: Bottom stack
t1-bottom-stack.visual_hint: Keep the lower half of the frame darker and visually uncluttered; place the subject in the upper half. No text, letters, signage, logos or watermarks anywhere.
t1-bottom-stack.hierarchy: duration is the largest line; location is at least as large as audience

t2-top-bottom-split.name: Top / bottom split
seen_in: Mount Dora, HPA ('MOUNT DORA AREA … LADIES WANTED')
t2-top-bottom-split.visual_hint: Subject centred in the middle band of the frame; keep the top quarter and the bottom third darker and uncluttered. No text, letters, signage, logos or watermarks anywhere.
t2-top-bottom-split.hierarchy: duration is the largest line; location is at least as large as audience

t3-right-column.name: Right column
seen_in: Asheville, boxing blue ('LADIES WANTED … FITNESS KICKSTART')
t3-right-column.visual_hint: Subject in the left half of the frame; keep the right half darker, plain and uncluttered. No text, letters, signage, logos or watermarks anywhere.
t3-right-column.hierarchy: duration is the largest line; location is at least as large as audience

t4-centred-stack.name: Centred full stack
t4-centred-stack.visual_hint: A dark, moody frame with the subject filling it; even, low-key lighting with no bright patches, so text can sit over the whole image. No text, letters, signage, logos or watermarks anywhere.
t4-centred-stack.hierarchy: duration is the largest line; location is at least as large as audience

t5-offer-band.name: Offer on a band
seen_in: Mount Dora, purple pill ('High Performance Aging Transformation Program')
t5-offer-band.visual_hint: Subject in the middle of the frame; keep the top fifth and the bottom third darker and uncluttered. No text, letters, signage, logos or watermarks anywhere.
t5-offer-band.hierarchy: duration is the largest line; location is at least as large as audience

t6-left-column.name: Left column
seen_in: Asheville ladies, MMA cage ('ASHEVILLE LADIES WANTED … FITNESS KICKSTART')
t6-left-column.visual_hint: Subject in the right half of the frame; keep the left half darker, plain and uncluttered. No text, letters, signage, logos or watermarks anywhere.
t6-left-column.hierarchy: duration is the largest line; location is at least as large as audience

t7-collage.name: Collage
t7-collage.visual_hint: One tile of a 3×3 collage: a tight, action-filled crop with one clear subject, moody low-key lighting. No text, letters, signage, logos or watermarks anywhere.
t7-collage.hierarchy: duration is the largest line; location is at least as large as audience

t8-panels-band.name: Panels + band
t8-panels-band.visual_hint: A square photo with one clear subject centred, on a plain background — it will be cropped to a circle. No text, letters, signage, logos or watermarks anywhere.

9x16.note: Hand-tuned from the derived 9:16 layout: the text groups are unchanged; the circles are enlarged to the full width between them, and a blurred, dimmed copy of the first photo fills the frame, so the areas the app covers carry imagery instead of flat backdrop (the derived version left ~60% of the frame plain).

t8-panels-band.hierarchy: duration is the largest line; location is at least as large as audience
